definition: Sharding a long sequence across devices and passing key-value blocks around a ring so attention is computed over the full context that no single GPU could hold.
details: Sharding a long sequence across devices and passing key-value blocks around a ring so attention is computed over the full context that no single GPU could hold. The systems technique that makes million-token context windows physically trainable and servable.

explainer.lead: Ring Attention shards a long sequence across devices and passes key-value blocks around a ring so attention is computed over the full context that no single GPU could hold. It matters because it is the systems technique that makes million-token context windows physically trainable and servable.

tiers.eli5: No single worker can hold the whole document, so the workers sit in a circle and pass chunks to each other until everyone has seen the whole thing.
tiers.practitioner: Engineers split sequences across devices and circulate key-value blocks around the ring to compute attention over the full context. A pitfall is that the approach is a systems technique, so its value depends on the communication pattern across devices rather than on a change to the attention math.
tiers.paperLevel: A long sequence is sharded across devices, with key-value blocks passed around a ring so attention covers the full context that no single GPU could hold; it enables million-token context windows to be physically trained and served.

explainer.example: A sequence too long for one GPU's memory is divided among several devices, which exchange key-value blocks in a ring so every device can attend over the entire sequence.
